title: Open a sub-account for a member
description: Opens a new sub-account for a member up through posting the transaction. The final step is classified risky by policy.yaml and requires human confirmation when run unattended -- this artifact exists to demonstrate the escalation/handoff mechanism (Phase 6), not as a fully general capability.
goal: open a new sub-account for a member and post the transaction

params.name: member_id
params.description: The member number to open the sub-account for.

target.name: Member #:
target.rationale: Same adjacent-left-cell targeting as lookup_member_savings_balance's step 0 -- no <label for> in this form either.

locator.name: Member #:
locator.rationale: Re-resolved rather than reusing a live reference, per the ref/locator distinction.

checkpoint.description: the member field visibly holds the value we just typed

target.name: Sub-Account Type:
target.rationale: Adjacent-left-cell targeting; the select carries no name of its own.

steps.note: Fixed choice for this demo artifact -- not parameterised, since the point is exercising the escalation path, not sub-account-type selection.

target.name: Continue
target.rationale: Named by its own value attribute (a submit input) -- the strongest targeting available.

locator.name: Post Transaction
locator.rationale: Same locator as the next step's target -- this click's own effect is best asserted by what the next step needs to already be true, not by the URL alone.

checkpoint.description: the review screen (with a Post Transaction button) is showing

target.name: Post Transaction
target.rationale: Named by its own value attribute. Classified 'risky' by policy.yaml's risky_control_patterns on caption alone ('post ... transaction') -- this is the step design rule 5 exists for: risk is a property of (action, target), not the click verb.

locator.name: SUB-ACCOUNT OPENED
locator.rationale: The confirmation page's own status text, static and independent of which member/type was posted.

checkpoint.description: the transaction was posted and the confirmation screen is showing

steps.note: The irreversible step. Escalates when unattended; see keystone/escalation/controller.py for the handoff mechanism this step is designed to exercise.

locator.name: SUB-ACCOUNT OPENED
locator.rationale: Independent re-assertion of the flow's overall goal against the live surface.

success.description: the sub-account was opened and posted

approval.note: Hand-authored to exercise the escalation/handoff mechanism (Phase 6) against a real risky step already classified by policy.yaml. Not intended for unattended production use as-is -- the sub-account type is hardcoded.
